components.title: myAirPlay service
components.description: For the app myAirPlay: the AirPlay receiver "BMW iDrive" (UxPlay's protocol on the head unit). The iPhone's screen mirroring decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file and its sound into SmartXbar's CarLife input; a video sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by its own player from the internet (mgu-uplink, through a proxy running as uid 13102). Opens the firewall for its ports only while the receiver runs.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Engine Care
components.description: PHEV B48 operating hours, EV vs ICE split, cold hard starts, engine runs that never warm the oil, battery charge at engine starts and true oil degradation next to BMW CBS

components.title: Hybrid Cost
components.description: PHEV running cost calculator: live electric vs petrol cost per 100 km in 11 currencies, dynamic torque split, trip savings and a price editor for fuel and electricity

components.title: myAirPlay
components.description: The head unit as an AirPlay receiver for an iPhone: screen mirroring on the centre screen with the sound on the car's speakers (also with wireless CarPlay connected), and videos sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by the head unit itself, with their controls on the iDrive. The picture shows while parked. Needs the myAirPlay service.

components.title: Wheel Heating
components.description: Steering wheel heating on/off from a favourite button: for a heated iDrive 8 (LCI) steering wheel without its own button, fitted to an iDrive 7 car
